title: Relinquishment no bar to jurisdiction.
bodyText: The forfeiture, nonrenewal, surrender, or voluntary relinquishment of a license by a licensee shall not bar jurisdiction by the licensing authority to proceed with any investigation, action, or proceeding to revoke, suspend, condition, or limit the licensee's license or fine the licensee.
bodyHtml: §436B-22  Relinquishment no bar to jurisdiction.  The forfeiture, nonrenewal, surrender, or voluntary relinquishment of a license by a licensee shall not bar jurisdiction by the licensing authority to proceed with any investigation, action, or proceeding to revoke, suspend, condition, or limit the licensee's license or fine the licensee. [L 1991, c 111, pt of §2; am L 1992, c 202, §18]
